verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents stock certificates as part of its smart-linked document chain tied to cap table entries, and it supports in-platform e-signing of generated documents. However, no evidence describes a dedicated electronic certificate issuance workflow or states that certificates themselves are signed in-platform. Missing for 10: an explicit electronic share certificate issuance workflow, confirmation that certificates are signed in-platform, any statement on legal validity of the signatures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue electronic share certificates that are legally signed in-platform and permanently linked to the cap table entry they represent
